title: SpecForge Recorded Test Report
description: specforge-report.json: the tests `specforge collect` recorded, per entity id. `analyze`, `stats` and every coverage view read it; a file that does not match is E045 (ADR 0069).

runner.description: The collectors whose results it holds, joined ", ".

results.description: Per entity id, the tests recorded for it.

name.description: The test's name as its runner reports it.

status.description: The protocol's TestStatus. collect records passed and failed; a skipped test proves and fails nothing.

verify.description: The exact text of the obligation the test proves.

duration_ms.description: How long the test took, in milliseconds.

runner.description: The collector that recorded the test.
